subject: Create launchd plist (com.you.capo.plist) with KeepAlive and explicit PATH
description:
Write `scripts/com.you.capo.plist` per §13 mitigation and blueprint expectations. `KeepAlive` true, `RunAtLoad` true, App Nap disabled, explicit `PATH` including Homebrew (`/opt/homebrew/bin`) and the venv bin directory.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Plist runs `python -m capo` (or equivalent) with the venv interpreter.
- [ ] `EnvironmentVariables` includes explicit `PATH` covering Homebrew (`/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`) and venv bin so `claude` and `codex` are findable.
- [ ] `KeepAlive` true → restart on crash; `RunAtLoad` true.
- [ ] App Nap disabled (`ProcessType = Interactive`, or `LimitLoadToSessionType` as appropriate).
- [ ] Stdout/stderr to a log file under `~/Library/Logs/capo/`.
- [ ] Boot crash → restart < 5s (per §6.4 reliability target).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Apple Silicon vs Intel: comment notes the Homebrew path differences and how to adjust.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Manual: `launchctl load` and `launchctl unload` cleanly cycle the process
• Manual: kill the process; verify it restarts < 5s

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 6.4, 9.5, 11.1, 13
